View, copy, export, or clear the bounded developer event log

Developer Mode keeps a capped app-private diagnostic event log. It records safe sync and restore phases, counts, photo placeholder reasons, blob paths, byte sizes, content hashes, and sanitized errors. Robia stores backups in Google Drive app data (appDataFolder), so it is normal not to see these files in My Drive.
No diagnostic events yet. Events are only recorded while Developer Mode is enabled.
